description: This file defines the Product model class within the Opencart e-commerce framework. It manages product-related data interactions with the database, including retrieving product details, discounts, images, attributes, options, related products, specials, and logging product reports. The class extends the system's base Model class and uses various queries and caching mechanisms to handle product data efficiently.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Model class for handling product data operations such as fetching, updating, and managing product-related information in the database within the Opencart framework.

methods.name: editQuantity
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specified product in the database.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves product details for a given product ID, including pricing, description, and related attributes.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Fetches a list of products based on provided filter criteria, with support for sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalProducts
methods.description: Returns the total count of products that match given filter criteria.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Fetches categories associated with a specific product.

methods.name: getCategoriesByCategoryId
methods.description: Gets category details for a given product ID and category ID.

methods.name: getTotalCategoriesByCategoryId
methods.description: Returns count of categories associated with a product and category ID.

methods.name: getCodes
methods.description: Retrieves product code records for a specific product.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Fetches attribute groups and their attributes for a product.

methods.name: editOptionQuantity
methods.description: Updates the quantity for a specific product option value.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Retrieves a specific product option record.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Fetches all options for a product, including their values.

methods.name: getOptionValue
methods.description: Retrieves details for a specific option value of a product.

methods.name: getOptionValues
methods.description: Gets all option value records for a specific product option.

methods.name: getDiscounts
methods.description: Returns discount records for a product.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Fetches images associated with a product.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves a subscription record for a product with a given subscription plan.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Gets all subscription records for a product.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the layout ID assigned to a product.

methods.name: getRelated
methods.description: Gets related products for a specific product.

methods.name: getSpecials
methods.description: Fetches special (discounted) products based on filters.

methods.name: getTotalSpecials
methods.description: Returns total number of products with specials.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Creates a new report record for a product visit.
